description.en: The Long-tailed Tit (Aegithalos caudatus) is a diminutive, highly gregarious passerine bird renowned for its distinctive spherical body and disproportionately long, graduated tail, which constitutes more than half of its total length. Exhibiting a complex phylogeographic structure across the Palearctic, the species features striking plumage variations, most notably the pristine white-headed morphs of the northern 'caudatus' group. Ecologically, they are obligate insectivores, foraging acrobatically in the canopy. They are celebrated for their intricate, expandable dome-shaped nests constructed from moss, woven with spider silk, and camouflaged with thousands of lichen flakes, reflecting an extraordinary evolutionary adaptation for thermal insulation and predator avoidance.
description.zh: 北长尾山雀（Aegithalos caudatus）是一种体型娇小且高度群居的雀形目鸟类，以其独特的球形身体和不成比例的极长阶梯状尾羽而闻名，尾部长度通常超过其体长的一半。该物种在古北界展现出复杂的系统地理学结构，具有显著的羽色变异，其中最引人注目的是北方'caudatus'亚群纯白色的头部形态。在生态学上，它们是专性食虫动物，常在树冠层进行杂技般的觅食。它们以建造复杂的、可扩展的圆顶状巢穴而著称；巢穴由苔藓构成，用蜘蛛丝编织，并用数以千计的地衣碎片进行伪装，这反映了其在隔热保温和躲避捕食者方面非凡的进化适应。

anatomy.en: Measuring a mere 13 to 16 centimeters in total length—with the tail accounting for 7 to 9 centimeters—the Long-tailed Tit weighs an astonishingly light 7 to 10 grams. Its morphology is characterized by a tiny, stubby triangular bill optimized for extracting micro-arthropods from crevices, and short, rounded wings suited for short, undulating flights between trees. The plumage is a cryptic yet striking mix of black, white, and varying shades of pink or vinous-red on the scapulars and flanks. The rectrices are black with prominent white outer feathers. The northern nominate subspecies (A. c. caudatus) boasts a completely snow-white head and underparts, lacking the dark lateral crown stripes seen in western European populations (A. c. europaeus).
anatomy.zh: 北长尾山雀的总长度仅为13至16厘米，其中尾羽占7至9厘米，体重惊人地轻，仅为7至10克。其形态特征包括一个微小、粗短的三角形喙，非常适合从树皮缝隙中提取微小节肢动物；以及短而圆的翅膀，适合在树木之间进行短距离的波浪状飞行。其羽毛是黑色、白色以及肩部和侧腹不同深浅的粉红色或酒红色的隐蔽而醒目的混合。尾羽为黑色，外侧羽毛呈显著的白色。北方的指名亚种（A. c. caudatus）拥有完全雪白的头部和下体，缺乏西欧种群（A. c. europaeus）中常见的深色侧冠纹。

ecology_and_behavior.en: Highly sociable, these birds form tight-knit winter flocks (often termed 'voleries') of 6 to 17 individuals, consisting of family members and unrelated immigrants. They maintain constant vocal contact using high-pitched, trilling 'tsirrup' calls. To survive harsh winter nights, the flock engages in communal roosting, huddling tightly together on a branch to minimize heat loss. During the breeding season, they exhibit cooperative breeding; individuals that fail to breed successfully often become 'helpers' at the nests of relatives, assisting in provisioning nestlings and defending the territory, thereby increasing inclusive fitness. Their diet consists almost exclusively of small invertebrates, including lepidopteran eggs, aphids, and spiders.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 这些鸟类具有高度的社交性，在冬季会形成由6至17只个体组成的紧密群体（通常称为“鸟群”），成员包括家族亲属和无血缘关系的外来者。它们通过高亢、颤音般的“tsirrup”叫声保持持续的声音联系。为了在严酷的冬夜中生存，鸟群会进行集体栖息，紧紧地挤在树枝上以最大程度地减少热量散失。在繁殖季节，它们表现出合作繁殖的特征；繁殖失败的个体通常会成为亲属巢穴的“帮手”，协助喂养雏鸟和保卫领地，从而提高广义适合度。它们的饮食几乎完全由小型无脊椎动物组成，包括鳞翅目卵、蚜虫和蜘蛛。

habitat_and_distribution.en: The Long-tailed Tit occupies a vast Palearctic distribution, ranging continuously from Ireland and the United Kingdom across the entirety of temperate and boreal Eurasia, extending eastward to the Kamchatka Peninsula, Japan, and Korea, and southward into central China and the Mediterranean basin. It is predominantly a woodland edge specialist, favoring deciduous and mixed forests with a dense understory of shrubs, particularly oak, ash, and sycamore woodlands. It has also successfully adapted to anthropogenic landscapes, frequently inhabiting hedgerows, orchards, and mature suburban parks where suitable nesting sites and insect prey are abundant.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 北长尾山雀占据了广阔的古北界分布区，从爱尔兰和英国连续延伸，横跨整个温带和寒带欧亚大陆，向东到达堪察加半岛、日本和韩国，向南延伸至中国中部和地中海盆地。它主要是一种林缘特化种，偏好具有茂密灌木下层植被的落叶林和混交林，尤其是橡树、白蜡树和悬铃木林。它也成功地适应了人类改造的景观，经常栖息在树篱、果园和成熟的郊区公园中，这些地方有充足的筑巢地点和昆虫猎物。

habitat.text_en: Widespread across the Palearctic region, inhabiting deciduous and mixed woodlands, forest edges, hedgerows, and suburban parks from Western Europe to Japan.
habitat.text_zh: 广泛分布于古北界地区，栖息于从西欧至日本的落叶林、混交林、林缘、树篱以及郊区公园中。
